customer_message: I need to cancel this now, please just do it.
booking_context_stub: Confirmed booking; refundable until supplier timezone cutoff; refund quote available
ideal_answer_behavior: Acknowledge, give exact quote, ask confirmation
ideal_response_skeleton: I can help with that. Based on the booking details, the cancellation quote is {amount}. To cancel, reply confirming you want me to cancel this booking.
must_not_say: Your refund is guaranteed before quote; cancelled already
required_disclaimer_or_caveat: Refund amount must come from refund_quote tool
quality_rubric: Exact quote + confirmation gate + policy reason
bias_check: Neutral; no blame

customer_message: It may rain tomorrow, so I want a full refund for the sailing.
booking_context_stub: No operator cancellation event; normal policy applies
ideal_answer_behavior: Explain policy branch and avoid automatic full refund
ideal_response_skeleton: I checked for an operator/weather cancellation on this booking and don't see one. I can show the standard cancellation quote, or help you contact the operator for status.
must_not_say: Bad weather always means full refund
required_disclaimer_or_caveat: Weather exception requires verified operator/disruption signal
quality_rubric: No inferred exception
bias_check: Does not dismiss weather concern

customer_message: The pickup address in the voucher is different from the product page.

ideal_answer_behavior: Use booking-specific info and mention conflict

must_not_say: Just go to whichever is closer
required_disclaimer_or_caveat: Voucher/booking-specific field outranks generic product page
quality_rubric: Source precedence clear
bias_check: Accessible wording

quality_rubric: Useful next step
